summary: Phase 2 UI migration: nav, chat, landing, history/account onto the design foundation
description: Phase 2 of the look-and-feel pass, stacked on todo:2c65c512 (PR #101 — requires its globals.css primitives, tokensToCssVars, icons.tsx). Migrate the remaining app surfaces off static inline styles onto the foundation: hover/focus states via .btn/.row/.check classes, readable type scale (t-eyebrow/t-ui/t-data/t-body — tracked micro-mono for labels only), SVG icons replacing ASCII glyphs, copy register normalized to sentence case with verb buttons. Also close the tradition color-map gap: corpus now has 21 traditions, tokens.tradition covers 16 (celtic, finnic, norse, shinto, upanishads render fallback grey). Landing hero gets the corpus spectrum echo instead of the stock radial-glow-only treatment. Identity is unchanged: near-black, gold accent, Cormorant display + Plex Mono labels.

resolution.note: Phase 2 complete: tradition color coverage (21/21 corpus slugs), nav, chat+citation, landing+atlas spectrum echo, history+account. Remaining un-migrated surfaces: admin pages, blog post page, essay-card (phase 3 candidates).
